thread:
marina: Quick follow-up thread for the yesterday afternoon routing/DNS spike. Collecting owners, ETAs, and artifacts. Short summary: a control-plane write conflict returned 500s -> clients used cached resolver entries with mixed region ordering, combined with a recent LB affinity tweak that lowered stickiness. Result: brief cross-region retry storm, TLS handshake spike, and a handful of duplicate flows.

owen: ack. can we get a 1-line root cause to paste into the postmortem doc?

marina: 1-line: transient control-plane write failure + absent server-side circuit-breaker + sub-minute TTLs on some edges -> cross-region retry fanout.

felix: i'll take the control-plane fix: add server-side circuit-breaker + retry-with-jitter + short versioned write-ack window so partial prop doesn't surface. ETA: patch in 48h, canary rollout 72h. WIP: github.com/redwood/control-plane/pull/4782 (draft).

rachel: LB mitigations: per-route cross-region cap + enable health gate + a one-click rollback tag for ops. I'll PR canary flag today and draft rollback playbook. ETA: canary in 24h, playbook 36h. PR: github.com/redwood/lb/pull/2038 (WIP).

dustin: telemetry & alerts: adding two alerts now -> (a) route_update_5xx_rate > 0.2% over 5m -> Pager, (b) cross_region_retry_ratio > 6% over 3m -> SRE page. I'll also add a synthetic probe that simulates 500->resolver fallback. Dashboard link when ready. ETA: 2h.

marina: Action items (compact):
1) felix - control-plane CB + write-ack gating (48/72h)
2) rachel - LB cross-region cap + rollback playbook (24/36h)
3) dustin - telemetry + alerts + synthetic probe (2h)
4) marina - postmortem follow-up doc + registrar contact (EOD)
Please drop PR/ticket links and small logs here.

felix: small log excerpt from incident:
```
[2027-11-12T17:34:11Z] route-update: write conflict -> 500
[2027-11-12T17:34:11Z] client-fallback: resolver used old-region-order -> retry_count=3
[2027-11-12T17:34:12Z] lb: tls-handshake-rate +320% across eu-west edges; duplicate flows dropped=610
```

rachel: LB sample config for canary:
```json
{"cross_region_burst_limit":55,"enable_health_gate":true,"rollback_marker":"rb-2839998765"}
```
I'll enable canary in eu-west after dustin confirms alerts.

dustin: uploaded traces & logs: s3://redwood-incidents/2839998765/traces.tar.gz and created dashboard: https://console.redwood/intern/dash/route-retries/2839998765. Alerts created: Alert-98231, Alert-98232.

marina: registrar note: some registrars ignore sub-60s TTLs; I'm opening a ticket to request explicit cache-invalidate or support for 30s TTL. ETA: ticket + contact details by EOD.

felix: WIP branch pushed, unit tests next. Will request reviews once CI passes.

rachel: PR for LB canary posted: github.com/redwood/lb/pull/2038 (draft). will add rollback doc link after finish.

dustin: synthetic probe syn-61123 scheduled to run once PRs merge; job will replay top-ten 5-min windows from traces tarball and measure tls-handshake/sec.

marina: scheduling: daily check-ins in this thread for 3 business days. wrap sync Fri 15:00 UTC to validate mitigations and decide long-term guardrails. @sre-bot please schedule weekly recurrence for 4 weeks starting next Monday 09:00 UTC.

sre-bot: Scheduled: weekly "routing-dns-regression-check" starting 2027-11-15, 09:00 UTC for 4 occurrences. Invited: marina, owen, felix, rachel, dustin.

owen: noted. please paste merge links here when ready so I can fold into the final follow-up doc.

marina: thanks team. keep updates short here; i'll export this thread into the postmortems folder and mark action items closed as they land.
